synthesis.calibrated_claim: GAP-4 rule-execution verifier — two-point transfer curve (ARC-1 contaminated/easy -> ARC-2 reduced-exposure/hard; both rounds 5/5 hostile-panel CONFIRMS, bit-exact re-derivation, transcripts leak-clean): codex-induced Python rule + execution-consistency verification is a REAL capability whose rerank venue pays ONLY where the candidate generator is strong-but-mis-voted. ARC-1 point (n=31 entries/30 unique; pool content-verbatim in public ARC-AGI-2 training2 INCLUDING test inputs — maximally contaminated): induction (demo-perfect) 29/31=0.935; demo-fit precision P(gold|demo-perfect)=26/29=0.897; true-gold 26/31=0.839; the exact-match gate fired and paid — TRM_VOTE 0.4516 -> GAP4_GATED 0.5806 pass@2, +4 recovered/-0 lost; cost 44 calls/1387.2 codex-s (46.2 s/unique-task). ARC-2 point (n=31 entries/23 unique from public evaluation2; 0/23 in training2, but 2/23 are content-identical ARC-1-eval reuses and eval2 itself is public-era — a reduced-exposure, increased-difficulty probe, NOT held-out): induction 16/31=0.516 entries (13/23 unique after sandbox-blacklist false-positive regrade; Fisher p=4e-4); precision 8/16=0.50 (8/17=0.47 corrected; p=0.0085); true-gold 8/31=0.258 (end-to-end p=8.2e-6); cost 56 calls/5780.4 codex-s (251.3 s/unique-task, 5.4x ARC-1). The decay is honest transfer decay, not collapse-to-recall: demo-overfit (demo-perfect-but-test-WRONG) rises 10.3% -> 50% (Fisher p=0.0085, ~4.8x) — memorization predicts the opposite signature — and the single maximally-exposed task (16b78196, content-identical 5-years-public ARC-1-eval reuse) fails completely at demo_fit 0.0 across all 3 iterations: exposure does not function as recall in this pipeline. Corollary: ARC-1's 0.897 precision is an UPPER BOUND on genuine induction (measured on a contaminated pool), and the design cannot decompose difficulty from residual contamination — neither component is claimed separately. Gate safety does NOT transfer: with a weak pool (TRM oracle 4/31=0.129 vs ARC-1's 19 oracle entries) the exact-match gate fired 0/31 (pred_in_pool=0), so GAP4_GATED is bit-identical to TRM_VOTE (2/31=0.0645 pass@2) and '0 recovered/0 lost' is vacuous; the 8 demo-perfect-but-wrong predictions are near-misses (6/8 same-shape, Hamming 0.002-0.032), so at 0.50 precision the ARC-1 '+4/-0' safety record must not be quoted forward. On hard tasks the value migrates to the GENERATOR plus a graded selector: codex-standalone true-gold 0.258 is 2.0x the pool oracle ceiling 0.129 (descriptive — gold sets fully disjoint, paired p=0.388; vs TRM's global 0.0125 rate p~3e-7), a codex-first hybrid reaches 9/31=0.290 pass@2 (4.5x gated), and the only live rerank signal is GRADED min-Hamming promoting a 1/493-cells-off gold from vote-rank 2 to 1 (GRADED pass@1 0.0645 > GATED 0.0323) — exact-match gating is too brittle for ARC-2. Honest next moves, in order: (1) consistency-ensemble precision fix — k=2-3 INDEPENDENT inductions per task with an agreement gate (micro-evidence: 3 independent demo-perfect pairs, agreement 2/3, agreed-pairs gold 3/3 vs 0.50 unconditional; measured recall cost exists, cf. 446ef5d2); (2) graded execution-energy gate (demo_fit==1.0 AND min-Hamming <= ~0.005), validated FIRST on the non-degenerate ARC-1 venue (graded 0.5484 vs gated 0.5806 there — must not lose vote-wins); (3) effort scaling — adaptive iteration caps (67.3% of ARC-2 codex-seconds burned on 11 never-demo-perfect tasks) and timeout >= 600s retry of 269e22fb (all 3 iterations hit the 300s cap on an oracle-hit task — part of the venue degeneracy is infrastructure); (4) a local-generator arm (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B / gemma-4 GGUF) to remove the closed-weight codex dependency per decentralization rule 1 and measure whether induction transfers off gpt-5.5. A 400-task run is NOT yet worth it for the rerank venue — the gate is structurally inert where TRM is weak (scaling n cannot change pred_in_pool=0) and ~251 s/unique-task prices it at ~28 codex-hours; it becomes worth it ONLY after fixes (1)/(2) land, run as a codex-standalone + consistency-gated measurement where the question is generator-plus-selector precision, not pool-rerank.

Wording corrections wherever this probe is cited: (a) 'demo-overfit doubles' is wrong — 3/29=10.3% to 8/16=50% is ~4.8x ('precision halves' is the correct phrasing); (b) demote 'codex doubles the pool oracle ceiling' to descriptive — the codex-gold (6 unique) and TRM-oracle (3 unique) task sets are fully disjoint and a paired sign test gives p=0.388 (defensible only vs TRM's global 0.0125 indicative rate, p~3e-7, with subset-selection caveat); (c) fix cost framing — ARC-2 is 251.3 s/unique-task vs ARC-1's 46.2 (5.4x); '103 s' is seconds-per-call; (d) '0 recovered / 0 lost' must be described as vacuous (gate fired 0/31), not as a measured safety property.

Dedupe the per-entry histories duplication in results/arc3_gap4_arc2_induced_programs.json — a naive recount yields 76 calls/8809.6s vs the correct 56/5780.4s — and note the pool builder-name vestige ('arc3_gap3_stage2_eval_pool' inside arc3_gap4_arc2_eval_pool.json.gz) as provenance, not an error.

Operational follow-ups before any forward aggregation: validate the graded execution-energy gate (demo_fit==1.0 AND min-Hamming <= ~0.005) on the non-degenerate ARC-1 venue first (graded currently 0.5484 vs gated 0.5806 there — confirm no vote-wins lost before claiming the 7b80bb43-style recovery), and retry 269e22fb with timeout >= 600s (all 3 of its iterations died at the 300s cap; it is one of only 2 oracle-hit unique tasks, so part of the venue degeneracy is infrastructure).
synthesis.summary: Unanimous 5/5 CONFIRMS (all minor severity, all key_numbers_match, all calibration_sound) from hostile re-derivation, difficulty-vs-contamination, transcript/leak-audit, metric-interpretation, and bidirectional-steelman lenses. Every committed number reproduces bit-exact from real code on CPU: demo-perfect 16/31 entries (12/23 unique), post-hoc true-gold 8/31=0.2581 vs official evaluation2 solutions, P(gold|demo-perfect)=8/16=0.50, pool oracle 4/31=0.129, random 0.0014, all six rankers (vote=gated pass@2=2/31=0.0645), both LCG bootstrap CIs, 0 recovered/0 lost, 56 calls/5780.4 codex-s, 0 pool-label errors across 20,379 candidates, and 56/56 transcripts leak-clean despite sandbox-bypassed codex on a host holding the solutions. The committed interpretation survives: the 93.5%->51.6% induction and 0.90->0.50 precision decays are statistically real (Fisher p=4e-4 / p=0.0085; end-to-end p=8.2e-6), the demo-overfit asymmetry (10.3%->50%, p=0.0085) plus the complete failure (demo_fit 0.0) of the content-identical 5-years-public ARC-1 reuse 16b78196 certifies the ARC-2 numbers as genuine inference rather than recall, the exact-match gate fired 0/31 (pred_in_pool=0) so the rerank venue is structurally degenerate where TRM is weak, and codex-standalone 0.258 doubles the pool oracle ceiling (descriptive only; disjoint sets, paired p=0.388). Synthesis added value on three points: adjudicated the reviewer-1-vs-reviewer-2 conflict with fresh code (the 2 task-ID collisions ARE verbatim ARC-1-eval reuses — demo sets, test inputs, and test outputs content-identical, only demo order differs; reviewer 1's zero-overlap claim was an order-sensitive comparison artifact); verified the _FORBIDDEN substring blacklist bug mechanically (corrected induction 13/23, precision 8/17=0.47 — moves precision DOWN, reinforcing the honest-decay reading); and confirmed the artifacts are now git-tracked (reviewer 3's untracked finding already resolved). Residual unprovable: evaluation2 has been public since ~March 2025, so absolute codex-pretraining cleanliness cannot be established — the probe is reduced-exposure, not held-out, and the design cannot decompose difficulty from residual contamination (the committed text correctly does not claim decomposition). No finding flips any committed conclusion; worst severity is minor (artifact-hygiene and wording fixes).

title: Adversarial-verify round over the GAP-4 ARC-2 transfer-probe calibration
